requirements_summary: Workload: SaaS KB for customer support agents. Indexing scale: ~1.5-2.5M documents (short+medium docs), incremental daily delta ~20k. Query profile: high sustained QPS (typical 3k-5k; bursts to 8k). Flow: fast retrieval (ANN embeddings) -> light-weight reranker on top for precision. Targets: p50 <= 80ms, p95 <= 250ms for end-to-end answer generation under 5k QPS; cost per query must be under $0.002 (goal). Model prefs: open/quantized embeddings (cost-sensitive) + mid-size cross-encoder reranker; fallback to smaller reranker variant when under load. Needs: prefix/KV caching, batching controls, routing by latency region, basic residency options (EU subset), audit logs and KMS integration for keys.
